candidates.change_summary: Return the stored oracle address directly cast to IOracleProvider only if nonzero; otherwise return a fallback zero-address-cast oracle (changes returned value when stored oracle is zero).
Return a default empty PayoffDefinition (zeroed storage) instead of reading stored payoffDefinition, causing payoffDefinition() to return a different value.
Change currentVersion() to call oracle().currentVersion() without transforming the price (i.e., return the raw oracle version instead of applying payoffDefinition.transform).
Return the untransformed oracle version (skip transforming price) by removing the call to _transform and returning oracle().atVersion(oracleVersion) directly.
Change the IProduct.name() declaration to include a default implementation returning a different string, so calling name() on the contract returns that string instead of the stored state variable.

Implement a concrete default getter in the interface body returning a fixed different string to cause calls to symbol() (via interface dispatch) to return a different value when this unit's implementation is used.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function symbol() external view returns (string memory) { return "MUTATED_SYMBOL"; }

candidates.change_summary: Change controller() to return address stored but cast to IController only if non-zero, otherwise revert; this makes controller() sometimes revert instead of returning address(0), altering observable return behavior.
Change maintenance() to return controller().minCollateral() instead of stored _maintenance, altering visible maintenance(account) results.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function maintenance() public view returns (UFixed18) { return controller().minCollateral(); }

candidates.change_summary: Change fundingFee() to return the stored funding fee multiplied by 2 (observable change to returned value).
candidates.mutated_unit_code:
UFixed18Storage private constant _fundingFee = UFixed18Storage.wrap(keccak256("equilibria.perennial.UParamProvider.fundingFee"));
function fundingFee() public view returns (UFixed18) { return UFixed18.wrap(UFixed18.unwrap(_fundingFee.read()) * 2); }
